name: tofu cube protein plate
instructions:
A collection of variants on the same basic idea: SEASONED BAKED TOFU CUBES (super firm tofu + starch + seasonings, baked crisp) plated with other things that make the protein binge palatable. The tofu core recipe is fixed; the accompaniments rotate by variant. The purpose of this recipe is to collect those variants as they develop.

=== THE TOFU CORE (SAME ACROSS ALL VARIANTS) ===

INGREDIENTS:
- super firm tofu (no pressing needed), cut into large bite-sized cubes or thick planks
- cornstarch or potato starch (generous coat)
- garlic powder
- onion powder
- salt
- black pepper
- vegetable oil (toss or drizzle so the starch crisps in the oven)

PROCEDURE:
1. Cut the tofu into large cubes or thick planks (~1/2 inch and up). Bigger pieces read as the meal; small crumbles read as garnish.
2. Toss with the starch, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper — HEAVY seasoning hand; tofu is bland baseline and the starch coat has to carry both crunch and flavor.
3. Toss or drizzle with vegetable oil so the coating crisps rather than dusts.
4. Bake at ~425°F on a sheet pan until crisp and browned outside. One pan, no flipping required (flip once if you want more even browning).

=== VARIANT A — THAI PLATE (GOCHUJANG + BELL PEPPERS + BASIL SALAD) ===

COMPONENTS:
1. The baked tofu cubes (core recipe above).
2. GOCHUJANG + WHITE VINEGAR DIPPING SAUCE: whisk to a loose dip; start roughly equal parts and adjust — thinner for vinegar bite, thicker for gochujang depth.
3. CHOPPED RAW BELL PEPPER: bite-sized pieces, any color.
4. BASIL SALAD: torn fresh basil (parsley alongside welcome). No dressing — the dipping sauce and lime handle the acid.
5. LIME WEDGES: squeeze over anything.
6. Optional: a glob of cold cream cheese as a second contrasting dip (cool-fatty-tangy vs the sharp-fermented gochujang).

EATING IT: dip a tofu cube, grab a piece of bell pepper, squeeze lime, forkful of basil salad. Build-your-own bites.

=== VARIANT B — ROMESCO PLATE (ROMESCO + CHIPS + HONEY DRIZZLE) ===

COMPONENTS:
1. The baked tofu cubes (core recipe above) — with a DRIZZLE OF HONEY over the hot tofu.
2. [[mexicanized-romesco]] as the dip (or a plain romesco).
3. CORN CHIPS or PITA CHIPS for scooping the romesco alongside.

EATING IT: honey-drizzled tofu cubes dipped in romesco, chips + romesco between bites. The honey-on-crispy-tofu + smoky-pepper romesco combination covers the sweet-savory-smoky triangle.
notes:
=== WHY THIS RECIPE EXISTS — MAKING THE PROTEIN BINGE PALATABLE ===

The point of this recipe is eating a LOT of tofu protein in one sitting without it being a chore. The baked starch-crusted cubes are efficient to produce (one sheet pan, no skillet, no flipping) and genuinely pleasant to eat — but a plate of plain tofu cubes gets monotonous fast. The accompaniments are what keep the binge palatable: dips, fresh vegetables, acid, crunch. Each variant is a different answer to 'what goes around the cubes.'

This file COLLECTS VARIANTS of that formula as they develop. The tofu core stays fixed; the plate rotates.

=== THE TOFU CORE — RULES ===

- SUPER FIRM TOFU: no pressing needed, holds the cube shape, maximum protein density. Firm works if pressed but super firm is the recipe.
- LARGE CUBES / THICK PLANKS: bigger pieces read as the meal; small crumbles read as a garnish. ~1/2 inch and up.
- HEAVY SEASONING HAND: tofu is bland baseline. Starch + garlic powder + onion powder + salt + pepper, all generous. Under-seasoned tofu turns the whole plate flat.
- VEGETABLE OIL SO THE STARCH CRISPS: dry starch coat bakes to dust; oiled starch coat bakes to crust. Toss or drizzle before the bake.
- HOT OVEN (~425°F): under-crisped tofu reads soggy/boiled. The crisp exterior is what makes the cubes snackable at volume.

=== VARIANT A NOTES (THAI PLATE) ===

GOCHUJANG + WHITE VINEGAR: white vinegar (not white wine vinegar) — its flat neutral acid keeps the gochujang's fermented-chili depth in the foreground. Too-thick sauce sits on the tofu instead of coating it; err toward more vinegar.

BASIL SALAD: basil is the load-bearing herb; parsley alongside is welcome. No dressing on the salad — the plate's dips + lime do the work; a formal dressing would clutter the build-your-own logic.

CREAM CHEESE (OPTIONAL): a cold glob as the second dip. Keep it COLD — warmed cream cheese loses the temperature contrast with the hot tofu. Alternating between the sharp gochujang dip and the cool cream cheese is part of what keeps the plate interesting.

LIME: the finishing acid across the whole plate — tofu, salad, pepper, cream cheese all take it.

=== VARIANT B NOTES (ROMESCO PLATE) ===

HONEY DRIZZLE ON THE TOFU: drizzle over the hot cubes right out of the oven — the heat loosens the honey and it coats rather than clumps. Sweet-on-crispy-savory is the hook.

ROMESCO: [[mexicanized-romesco]] is the house version (smoky fire-roasted peppers + almonds + ancho). The smoky-nutty dip against the honey-sweet tofu covers the sweet-savory-smoky triangle.

CHIPS: corn chips or pita chips — they're the romesco delivery vehicle between tofu bites, and the crunch variety (chip-crunch vs starch-crust-crunch) keeps the texture interesting. This also matches the romesco serving guidance (dip with crackers/pita — see [[mexicanized-romesco]]'s serving note).

=== FAILURE MODES ===

TOFU UNDER-SEASONED OR UNDER-CRISPED: the cubes carry every variant. Under-seasoned = flat plate; under-crisped = soggy/boiled register. Hot oven, generous starch, generous seasoning, enough oil.

=== HISTORICAL NOTE — RENAMED FROM ITALIAN-ASIAN-TOFU-PLATE ===

This file was previously 'italian asian tofu plate' — a deconstruction of [[italian-asian-stuffed-bell-peppers]] (basil + parsley + gochujang + bell pepper + cream cheese, plated). That build survives as Variant A (thai plate), lightly renamed and simplified. The recipe's identity shifted from 'deconstructed stuffed peppers' to 'variant collector for the tofu-cube protein formula' — the tofu core turned out to be the real recipe, and the accompaniments are interchangeable plates around it.

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===

- [[italian-asian-stuffed-bell-peppers]]: the assembled, oven-baked, composed dish that Variant A descends from. Same flavor family, more work, presents better for others.
- [[mexicanized-romesco]]: the dip for Variant B.
